mentions.name: Competitive Coding Gameshow
mentions.description: This project is a competitive coding gameshow inspired by a mix of Great British Bakeoff, Battle Bots, and Dota. Contestants are dropped into a fully equipped dev machine (neovim, agent harnesses, custom styling, optional dotfiles cloning) and compete in timed coding sessions, optionally using AI agents. A working prototype live streams matches from Fly.io sprites to Twitch, with live voice-over or OpenAI-generated commentary, and matches are run as 3-minute demos with plans for 30-60 minute sessions whose VODs double as entertainment and reference examples of good development workflows.
